content.short: Unwanted Ones is a 2D pfp collection filled with animated traits.
content.description:
Unwanted Ones is a PFP project created by two creative friends: Kiwi and Sven. They own a creative studio irl. They aim to bring their skills from the outside world into the Cardano Space.

Creativity, animation, community and fun art drive this project forward.
